specification.problem: Quantum state tomography of n qubits using a complete set of mutually unbiased bases (MUBs) generated cyclically by a generator built from Hadamard and controlled-phase gates.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Smallest useful instance: 2-qubit (d=4) tomography with MUB-defining conditions and a cyclic-generator structure. The specific 3- and 4-qubit generators, entanglement classes and circuits from the abstract are outside this scope.

symbols.meaning: vectors of the a-th orthonormal basis
cyclic generator unitary built from Hadamard and controlled-phase gates (specific form not given)

symbols.domain: d x d positive semidefinite, trace 1

symbols.meaning: probability of outcome k in basis a

equations.label: Mutual unbiasedness
equations.description: Defining condition for two orthonormal bases to be mutually unbiased.
equations.justification: Standard definition of MUBs; the abstract names the concept only.

equations.label: Complete MUB set size
equations.description: A complete set has d+1 bases, which exists for prime-power d such as 2^n.
equations.justification: Known result for prime-power dimensions; the abstract mentions complete sets for three and four qubits.

equations.label: Cyclic generation (schematic)
equations.description: Bases obtained by repeated application of a generator U (schematic; the actual cycle structure and any permutation or relabeling are not specified).
equations.abstract_quote: cyclic generation of mutually unbiased bases
equations.justification: Inferred from 'cyclic generation'; the exact form of the cycle is not given.
assumptions: U^m acts as identity or permutes bases after a cycle of some length
Whether one cycle covers all bases is unspecified

equations.label: Generator gate content (schematic)
equations.description: Hypothetical form using Hadamards and controlled-phase gates with binary coupling pattern c_ij; the paper's actual generator is unknown.
equations.justification: The abstract says only that the generator needs Hadamard and controlled-phase gates.
assumptions: c_ij in {0,1} chosen per entanglement class

equations.label: Linear inversion reconstruction
equations.description: State reconstruction from the outcome probabilities of a complete MUB set.
equations.justification: Standard identity for complete MUBs using d+1 bases, with Tr(rho)=1.

registers.name: q
registers.role: system qubits being measured in each MUB

specification.initial_state: Unknown state rho on the n qubits to be reconstructed.

steps.description: For each basis index a, apply the circuit implementing the basis change, i.e. a power of the generator U built from H and CZ gates (exact form unspecified).
Measure all qubits in the computational basis to get outcome statistics p_k^(a) for each of the d+1 bases.

specification.measurement: Computational-basis measurement of all n qubits after the basis-change circuit, for each of the d+1 MUBs.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Linear inversion using estimated probabilities (eq_5); finite-statistics corrections such as positivity projection are not specified.
assumptions: Chosen scope is a tiny n=2 instance with standard MUB theory
The explicit generator form is a placeholder, not from the abstract
missing_information: Explicit generator U and the gate order and phase pattern
Cycle structure and how complete sets are covered
Entanglement classes of the bases for 3 and 4 qubits
